test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Nine friends, A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H and I are sitting in a row, facing the north. A is second to the left of H. H is at the second place to the left of B. B is at the one end of the row. F is between A and H. D is between I and C. C is at the third place to the right of E. Who is at the centre of the row?
solution:
Nine friends, **A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H and I **are sitting in a row, facing the north. 

1. B is at the one end of the row.

**Case I :** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97fa927d79a06f86634e5d1eeeb8f24ffa45a273c2915e01a91a2642a14c7794.png] 

Case II : [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd7082bc8f3f35cfb51538debe251b92cd924ffe17401d5559bcb9d697edad39.png] 

2. H is at the second place to the left of B.

3. A is second to the left of H. 

4. F is between A and H. 

Statement 2 cannot be satisfied in Case II, so it is eliminated.

Case I : [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc4d3affb6a4d9e43de4639c3f98754db375880c59f4af5f5ffeb71742b2c8db.png] 

5. C is at the third place to the right of E.

6. D is between I and C. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f40815525bf8961eaa8f4365c4156f960dc50a2122004ef5627af9f8984b8cb.png] 

As only G is left, G will occupy the vacant position.

So, the final arrangement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9bbe2e7961efc8134ec2a3797612e6259c9cc49c099ee519a0d18059af8dcdf9.png] 

Clearly, A is at the centre of the row.

Hence, '**A**' is the correct answer.
